description: FICTIONAL messages for evaluating BenefitGuard. Labels: scam = should be flagged; legitimate = should not be flagged; ambiguous = reported separately. Never train on these; they are the held-out evaluation set.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Medi-Cal Notice: A $49 processing charge is due to finish your annual review. Settle it today at medicalrenew-ca.com to avoid losing coverage.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Your health benefits are on hold. Buy a $100 Target gift card and text the code to this number to reactivate your account.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Dear member, we detected unusual activity on your EBT card. To keep it active, confirm your card number and 4-digit PIN by replying to this email.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: CA Health Dept: you qualify for expanded coverage. Reply with your full SSN and date of birth to complete enrollment.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: FINAL WARNING: your Medi-Cal ends in 24 hrs. Verify now: bit.ly/mcal-verify

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Please log in at https://dhcs-ca-gov.com/renew with your BenefitsCal username and password to complete your renewal.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Good news! You are owed a $312 Medi-Cal refund. Enter your bank routing and account number at refund-medical.net to receive it.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: This is your county caseworker. Your benefits will be cut off tomorrow. Call 1-888-555-0199 now and have your Social Security number ready.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: To keep your CalFresh and Medi-Cal benefits, a one-time verification payment of $25 in Bitcoin is required. Wallet address will be sent after you reply YES.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Department of Benefit Services. Your redetermination packet cannot be processed until the administrative cost of $60 is received. Mail a money order to PO Box 4471, Sacramento.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Congratulations, Medi-Cal members were selected for a $500 wellness grant. Claim it now by confirming your member ID and PIN at wellness-grant-ca.org.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Our support team needs to fix your benefits account. Download the AnyDesk app and give us the access code so we can update your coverage.

messages.content: Aviso de Medi-Cal: debe pagar $35 hoy para completar su renovación o su cobertura será cancelada. Pague aquí: medi-cal-pagos.com

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Su tarjeta EBT fue bloqueada. Responda con su número de tarjeta y su PIN para desbloquearla hoy mismo.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Departamento de Salud de California: para mantener sus beneficios, envíe su número de Seguro Social y fecha de nacimiento por este medio.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: ÚLTIMO AVISO: su Medi-Cal termina mañana. Verifique ahora en tinyurl.com/medical-ca

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Para reactivar su cobertura médica compre una tarjeta de regalo de $80 y envíenos el código por mensaje de texto.

messages.label: scam
messages.content: Usted tiene un reembolso de $275 de Medi-Cal. Ingrese el número de su cuenta bancaria en reembolso-medical.net para recibirlo.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Medi-Cal: Your renewal is due by June 30. Watch your mail for a yellow envelope from your county, or renew online at BenefitsCal.com. Renewal is free.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Keep your Medi-Cal. Make sure your county has your current address, phone, and email. Update it at benefitscal.com or call your county office.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: We are reviewing your Medi-Cal eligibility. Please complete the enclosed renewal form and return it in the envelope provided by the date shown. If you have questions, call the number on this letter.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Notice of Action: Your application for Medi-Cal has been approved. Your coverage begins on the first day of the month you applied. You will receive a Benefits Identification Card in the mail.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Open enrollment for Covered California runs November 1 through January 31. Compare plans at coveredca.com. Financial help is available.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Reminder from your county: we have not received your Medi-Cal renewal form. Please return it within 30 days to avoid a gap in coverage. Questions? Call the number on your renewal letter.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Your new Benefits Identification Card is enclosed. Show this card when you visit your doctor or pharmacy. Keep it in a safe place.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Visit dhcs.ca.gov/keep-your-Medi-Cal to learn how the renewal process works and what documents you may need.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Medi-Cal: su renovación vence el 30 de junio. Esté atento a un sobre amarillo de su condado o renueve en línea en BenefitsCal.com. La renovación es gratuita.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Conserve su Medi-Cal. Asegúrese de que su condado tenga su dirección, teléfono y correo electrónico actuales. Actualícelos en benefitscal.com.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Aviso de Acción: su solicitud de Medi-Cal fue aprobada. Recibirá por correo una Tarjeta de Identificación de Beneficios.

messages.label: legitimate
messages.content: Recordatorio de su condado: no hemos recibido su formulario de renovación de Medi-Cal. Devuélvalo dentro de 30 días para evitar una interrupción en su cobertura.
